What we do

Real help for
roadside breakdowns.

From a truck that won’t start to an air leak that stops your route, we bring the tools and diagnostics to your location.

01 / DIAGNOSTICS

Diesel diagnostics

Fault code checks, live data and troubleshooting to identify the cause before the repair.

02 / NO-START

Starting & battery issues

No-start and crank-no-start troubleshooting, jump starts, batteries and starting-system checks.

03 / AIR SYSTEMS

Air leaks & brake issues

Air-line leaks, fittings and air-system troubleshooting, with repairs suited to the location.

04 / ELECTRICAL

Electrical troubleshooting

Wiring, lights, sensors, charging systems and electrical faults that keep your truck off the road.

05 / AFTERTREATMENT

DEF & DPF diagnostics

Aftertreatment fault checks and diagnostic support for DEF, DPF and related warning lights.

06 / ON-SITE REPAIR

Truck & trailer service

Mobile repair at truck stops, fleet yards and breakdown locations. Call with your specific repair needs.

Repair options depend on the truck, parts availability and location. We’ll confirm what can be completed on-site.

Before you call

A few things
worth knowing.

What should I send when requesting service?

Your exact location or map pin, truck make and model, the problem and any fault codes. Photos can help us understand the repair and parts needed.

How soon can you arrive?

Arrival time depends on your location and our current schedule. Call us for availability and an estimated arrival time before dispatch.

Can every repair be done on the roadside?

Some repairs need a shop or a safer location. We’ll discuss the issue and confirm the repair options based on access, tools and available parts.

How much does a service call cost?

The cost depends on your location, the repair and parts required. Call with your truck details so we can discuss call-out and labor charges.

Do you work on my truck model?

We focus on heavy-duty diesel trucks and trailers. Tell us the make, model and repair needed so we can confirm whether we can assist.
